bounds.range_derivation: an accuracy is a probability, so it lies in [0,1] by definition; the lower end is raised to the base rate max_y P(Y=y) because every model class considered here contains the two constant functions, and no endpoint is taken from the roster's observed values

bounds.name: B3_modular_accuracy_when_condition_fails
bounds.range_derivation: an accuracy is a probability, so it lies in [0,1] by definition; the lower end is raised to the base rate max_y P(Y=y) because every model class considered here contains the two constant functions, and no endpoint is taken from the roster's observed values

violated_by.why: widening each block summary from one bit to two attains 1

attained_by.object: the complete fixed-length 16-bit truth-table code over all 2^16 functions

bounds.name: B4_kraft_sum_of_the_registered_code
bounds.note: the registered code's exact Kraft sum is 1372503309540478908673/2361183241434822606848
bounds.range_derivation: by definition the Kraft sum of a finite description set is a sum of positive powers of two, hence at least 0, and at most (number of descriptions)/2 because every codeword is at least one bit long; neither endpoint comes from the roster

violated_by.relaxed_class: the same code with the term-count field removed from the monolithic branch
violated_by.why: without the self-delimiting term count the branch is no longer prefix-free and the Kraft sum exceeds 1

bounds.name: B5_cycle_rank_of_a_proper_coset
bounds.range_derivation: the cycle rank of a graph is |E| - |V| + c >= 0 by definition, and the Hamming-1 graph of {0,1}^4 has n*2^(n-1) = 32 edges on 16 vertices, so any connected induced subgraph has cycle rank at most 32 - 16 + 1 = 17; both endpoints come from the definition

violated_by.why: the dimension-4 coset is the whole cube, with cycle rank 17

bounds.name: B6_interventional_effect_of_the_dimension_1_factor
bounds.range_derivation: the quantity is the largest absolute difference between two probabilities, hence lies in [0,1] by definition of a probability

violated_by.relaxed_class: sources on the same support whose dimension-1 factor is allowed to carry the target
violated_by.why: the same maximally low-dimensional factor now moves the target by the full amount

bounds.name: B7_information_of_the_dimension_1_factor
bounds.range_derivation: mutual information is non-negative, and with a binary target it is at most H(Y) <= log2(2) = 1 bit; both endpoints come from the definition of mutual information

violated_by.relaxed_class: sources on the same support whose dimension-1 factor is allowed to carry the target
violated_by.why: the factor then carries the whole bit of the target

null.detector: the support is an exact block product with a dimension-1 factor on block 1 and a full-dimension factor on block 2, the measure is a product measure, the exact mutual information between the dimension-1 factor and the target is 0 bits, the exact interventional effect of that factor on the target is 0, and some coordinate of block 2 determines the target exactly
null.finding: the detector fires on 3 of 200 randomized tasks over random block geometry; every firing trial is a genuine instance of the same phenomenon and is listed individually with its exact values, so the rate is a reproducibility rate and not a false alarm rate
null.magnitude_definition: best accuracy reading block 2 only minus best accuracy reading block 1 only
null.primary_comparison: the exact firing rate of the full conjunction over the registered 200 trials. The magnitude is bounded above by 1 - base rate <= 1/2 by definition, and the planted witness attains that definitional maximum, so a strictly-exceeds comparison on the magnitude is structurally impossible and is reported only for completeness
null.sampler: block supports drawn uniformly from the 15 non-empty subsets of each block's value set, product masses drawn as positive integers summing to 16 per block, target drawn uniformly over all assignments on the support

prospective_predictions.claim: the six structure classes form a strictness table in which each ordered pair is either witnessed by a registered source in the first and not the second, or explicitly reported as not separated on the roster
S_NONMANIFOLD_LEARNABLE violates the smooth-manifold assumption at the registered scope and is learned to exact accuracy 1 by a member of the registered rule class
S_LOWDIM_USELESS has GF(2) intrinsic dimension 1, exact mutual information 0 bits with Y and exact interventional effect 0, while a full-dimension coordinate carries Y exactly
prospective_predictions.why: the conjunction is unsatisfiable on any support: a deterministic target with exact zero mutual information is constant, and a constant target is not determined by any coordinate in the sense of equalling it or its complement while that coordinate varies. The repaired composite witness S_LOWDIM_USELESS_COMPOSITE realizes every conjunct with the dimension-1 object taken as the exact GF(2) factor of the support rather than the whole support, and it is what closes the row.

prospective_predictions.claim: each of the three derivations holds with an exact rational condition AND has a registered matched failure counterexample in which the condition fails and the named architecture class is strictly worse; a derivation whose condition never fails on the roster is reported as UNFALSIFIED_CONDITION and does not close its row

every threshold emitted carries a bound record with range_lo and range_hi derived from the definition of the bounded quantity, a vacuous flag, an attained_by witness and a violated_by witness from an explicitly relaxed class
